name: stockpulse
description: StockPulse full-stack stock learning dashboard with paper trading and educational AI insights.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix client && npm run test --prefix server
scripts.test:watch: concurrently "npm run test:watch --prefix client" "npm run test:watch --prefix server"
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix client && npm run test:coverage --prefix server
